LTX Video 2.3 — 多阶段工作流程集合

专为高端硬件构建的 LTX Video 2.3 工作流程集合，注重质量而非速度。 AIO 的设计没有获取/设置节点，除了文本/图像组合工作流程或子图之外还具有其他功能。

管道变体

两级

草稿 → 上采样 → RefineStandard 管道

三级

四分之一 → 半 → 全 速度提高 4 倍 · 输出必须除以 128

胡莫

两阶段 + 运动通道 - 音频驱动的人体运动调节

万2.2 LN

两阶段 + 细化通道 - 所需的噪声比 HuMo 更低

特点

  • 音频潜在保留- 第一阶段的音频潜伏被进行细化而不是重新编码，从而保持跨通道的时序和纹理连贯性

  • 每阶段采样器和调度器调整— 每个阶段都使用独立配置的采样器和调度器

  • RTX 视频超分辨率输出 - 如果不需要，可以轻松删除

  • 尺寸和框架计算器节点— 可以更换为任何输入源；请注意，细化阶段有严格的维度要求

工作流程类型

T2V / I2V 切换 · 第一帧和最后一帧 · 音频 I2V · 身份 LoRA · 视频延续

大多数类型都适用于所有三种管道变体。

活跃的仓库位于https://github.com/ckinpdx/ckinpdx_comfyui_workflows我在这里发布作为完整集合的指导。请参阅那里的自述文件以了解更多详细信息。

o.en:
LTX Video 2.3 — Multi-Stage Workflow Collection

A collection of LTX Video 2.3 workflows built for high-end hardware, focused on quality over speed. Designed without get/set nodes, AIO functions aside from text/image combined workflows or subgraphs.

Pipeline Variants

Two-Stage

Draft → Upsample → RefineStandard pipeline

Triple-Stage

Quarter → Half → FullUp to 4x faster · output must be div-by-128

HuMo

Two-stage + motion pass - Audio-driven human motion conditioning

Wan 2.2 LN

Two-stage + refinement pass - lower denoise required than HuMo

Features

  • Audio latent retention— first-stage audio latent is carried into refinement rather than re-encoded, preserving timing and texture coherence across passes

  • Per-stage sampler & scheduler tuning— each stage uses independently configured samplers and schedulers

  • RTX Video Super Resolutionoutput — easily removed if not needed

  • Dimension & frame calculator nodes— can be swapped for any input source; note that refinement stages have strict dimensionality requirements

Workflow Types

T2V / I2V toggle · First & Last Frame · Audio I2V · Identity LoRA · Video Continuation

Most types are available across all three pipeline variants.

The active repo is found athttps://github.com/ckinpdx/ckinpdx_comfyui_workflowsI post here as direction to the full collection. Please see the readme there for more details.
